question: G, K, M, P, S and V live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it, number 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 6. G lives on floor number 3. Only one person lives between G and M. As many people live below K as above M. P lives immediately below S. How many people live above P?
solution:
Given: G, K, M, P, S and V live on six different floors of the same building.

The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it, number 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 6.

1) G lives on floor number 3.

2) Only one person lives between G and M.

3) As many people live below K as above M.
